Container IDs sourced from trusted runtime JSON listings. Zero net.Listen/setuid/YAML-unmarshal/template-engine in non-test code — pure CLI+TUI, no daemon. Two low-severity defense-in-depth notes surfaced but NOT PVR-filed (below the bar): (i) unicode.IsControl misses Unicode Cf category (BiDi override U+202E, ZWJ U+200D) — visual spoofing only, no code exec; (ii) install.sh curl-fetches release binary without SHA256 verification — standard curl|bash posture.
